title: fix(cli): type approvalFlow test helper — unbreak workspace build (follow-up #2279)
body: One-line follow-up to #2279: the `approvalFlow` test helper's `edges` param was implicitly `any`, which the strict cli `tsc` build (`tsconfig.build.json`) rejects — vitest/esbuild transpiled it without a full type-check, so it passed locally but broke the workspace **Build / TypeScript Type Check** jobs after merge. Typed it explicitly; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build` is green again. No behavior change. Refs #2274, #1770.
